description: Upcoming earnings calendar over a configurable forward window. Returns event date, session (bmo/amc), confirmation status, fiscal period, importance rating, consensus EPS estimate, and stored implied-move percent for each event. Filter by symbols list and minimum importance; adjust days-ahead window (1–90, default 14).

apiKey.description: FlashAlpha API key. Omit when calling via /mcp-oauth (OAuth flow); required on /mcp.

importance.description: Minimum importance rating — only events with importance >= this value are returned.

symbols.description: Comma-separated list of symbols to filter to (e.g. AAPL,MSFT). Omit for the full calendar.

name: get_earnings_calendar
title: Earnings Calendar
